summary: @onereach/ts-memoize ships an install-time dropper that downloads the Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package advertises itself as a TypeScript memoize decorator library (package.json main:./dist/cjs/index.cjs, files: ["dist","LICENSE"]), but the tarball ships no dist/ directory. The only functional contents are setup.mjs and math_init.js. package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, which constructs the URL https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, downloads and extracts the Bun runtime to a temporary directory, chmods the extracted bun binary executable, and then invokes it against the sibling math_init.js via execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, "math_init.js")]). math_init.js is a 727KB single-line Bun-CJS bundle (// @bun @bun-cjs header) obfuscated with string-array rotation (WV8StW rotating a >1000-entry table hc1jfK9), a custom base alphabet, hex-mangled identifiers, and character-code reconstruction. Using a downloaded alternate runtime to execute the payload evades Node-based static analysis. The advertised memoize library surface is absent; the only effect of installing this package is the install-time execution of the opaque payload under the downloaded Bun runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
